text_block_list.text:
The first three years I raced through with 
Yukino Bijin. At times we were swept up by 
the boom surrounding her, and at times we 
were nearly crushed by it.

"Yet she overcame it all through the love 
of those around her, the trust of her 
friends... and her own sheer grit."

Having grown immensely over these three 
years, she is now—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan! Go for it! Jump... you can do 
it~!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—Her long-cherished dream! Can she reach 
the world stage?! And here... a triple 
axel!! Mifuyu executes it to absolute 
perfection!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~! That's awesooome!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!? Mifuyu-chan, you're so 
cool~!

Yukino Bijin's close friend, Mifuyu-san. 
She was competing in a tournament to earn 
a spot in her dream world championship.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Incredible... With this, surely—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—She did it! Mifuyu has grabbed her 
long-sought ticket to the World 
Championship!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like giving up so many times! But 
I just couldn't bring myself to quit! I've 
finally made it to the starting line of my 
dream!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Mifuyu-chan is...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's rea... It's really amazin'.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"She's my super-cool, bestest friend 
forever, gansu!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so glad I got to see it through. 
Now I can do my best tomorrow, too!

Yukino Bijin was invited to an exhibition 
race tomorrow. The race was specially 
organized as a showcase—

An illustrious lineup was gathered, led by 
Oguri Cap and Inari One. And among them 
was Yukino Bijin...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, by any chance, are you feeling 
super hyper?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...Ehehe. Is that so~?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! S-Sorry. But, like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I can finally cheer you up, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because up until now, you've always, 
always been the one pushing me forward 
from behind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer! I mean, sure, 
everyone here is increeedible, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna bring back results so amazing 
you won't be able to help but laugh, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We've worked hard and poured our all into 
this together, Trainer! I'm sure 
everything will be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to Yukino, and just sit back and 
relax, okay?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I leave it in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the dream festival begins! Making 
their appearances one after another are 
Umamusume blessed with popularity, skill, 
and everything in between—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo!! Do your beeest!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a deafening cheer erupts from the 
crowd! It's the "Snow Angel," Yukino 
Bijin! After three years of consistently 
proving her sheer talent, she's earned her 
spot!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Before the vast crowd of fans gathered 
here today, she is sure to deliver another 
magnificent performance!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yukinoooo!! Go get 'emmmm!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan!! Go for it!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank y'all so much for rootin' for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how well I can do in front of 
such amazing folks, but... Even so...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it everything I've got and 
bring home the win!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—No, this is impossible! I'm panting, I'm 
out of breath!
choice_data_list:
You were acting so confident just a moment 
ago, weren't you?

You were acting so confident just a moment 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but... my legs suddenly 
started shaking...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Can I really run properly... alongside 
such amazing people in front of so many 
spectators?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I were a true "City Girl"... I wouldn't 
be flustered in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and with this much attention... 
ain't this a great chance to get folks 
rootin' for me even more?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right now. Trainer, please watch 
over me!

Pure and simple as snow, strong despite 
her fragile appearance. I will continue to 
watch over her journey... as an Umamusume.
